Subject: Post-signature orchestration: phased rollout + shadow-canary checklist (OrbitHealth)

Hi Jill / Tom —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get OrbitHealth into a production cadence. Attached is a first-pass orchestration checklist that embeds the post-signature timeline, the shadow (read-only) canary cadence, migration cutover windows, and training milestones. High-level asks from us to you in this first week:

- Confirm preferred weekly training window (2 x 90m sessions) between Jan 23–Feb 3.
- Identify a single procurement owner for billing and PO coordination (we have procurement@orbithealth.com on copy).
- Confirm whether the dev/staging datasets for shadow canary testing can be seeded by Jan 16 (we can provide a sanitized fixture).

What I’m proposing (very condensed):
1) Week 1 (Jan 9–13): final operational readiness checklist, security evidence handoff (SOC/retention summary), and scheduling.
2) Week 2–3 (Jan 16–27): shadow canary (read-only traffic), validation metrics capture, and quality review sessions.
3) Week 4 (Feb 1–3): staged migration rehearsals and train-the-trainer run; production cutover window target Feb 6–7.

Attachments: MAP-Orchestration-Checklist-v1.pdf, Canary-Test-Schedule.xlsx.

If that aligns, I’ll lock the timeline and send a short mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Mateo
Sr. Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
